Panchayat Season 5 Trailer Released, Hints at New Plotlines

The trailer for the fifth season of the web series 'Panchayat' has been released. The new season appears to introduce significant changes in the fictional village of Phulera, with Kranti Devi now holding the position of Pradhan. The trailer suggests potential plot developments including discussions around a liquor ban and the continuation of the love story between Rinky and Sachiv Ji.
